control.name: C0
control.claim: frozen causal control behaviorally identical to audited V125; not claimed globally strongest

data.bc_teacher_selection_rule: largest locally available complete replay corpus before test evaluation; expected 56216119
data.split_unit: episode_id; both seats and all duplicate source appearances remain in one split

training.selection: lowest validation loss; test is read once after checkpoint selection

smoke.purpose: end-to-end completion, runtime safety, model-use and first paired effect

evaluation.promotion_rule: no runtime failures; positive paired win-score difference on unused holdout; evidence from at least four independent executable opponent families; no automatic all-pair margin constraint
evaluation.early_rejection: runtime failure, zero delivered action changes, or smoke paired win-score decrease with a diagnosed mechanism; rejection of one arm does not stop another arm
